note: Refreshed now that GA4 + App Store Connect are live. The plumbing works; the early numbers (~2.4 avg DAU, 8 users/30d, 6 downloads since launch) say the content exists but distribution is the bottleneck. Priorities below reflect that.

items.title: Distribution is the #1 lever — content is built, reach isn't
items.why: ~2.4 avg DAU and 8 users in 30 days with 145 live articles means discovery, not supply, is the constraint. Reels (especially the hooked ones) and search are the two channels that move this.
steps: Keep the every-other-day AI reel cadence going; front-load the hooked reels
Share new Understory pieces where rare-aroid collectors gather (r/aroids, FB collector groups, Discords) — link in bio, not the article wall
Verify Google Search Console + submit the sitemap so the 145 articles start ranking

items.title: Watch the reel → article → install path
items.why: Only 6 downloads so far — every install matters and the funnel is now fully measurable. The 'articles that landed customers' panel will show which content converts the moment App Store clicks register.
steps: Run the Instagram insights weekly and check reel reach vs the 79% skip baseline
Watch the GA 'articles that landed customers' panel — double down on whatever article first drives App Store clicks

items.title: Validate the text hooks against the 79% skip rate
items.why: The hook rollout (days 8-46) targets reel retention; needs ~5 hooked reels live to read a signal.
steps: Once ~5 hooked reels have posted, compare avg watch time hooked (🪝) vs non-hooked in the insights
Up → expand hooks to all reels. Flat → iterate the copy on the weakest and re-test

items.title: Keep the content queues from drying up
items.why: The phone drip and daily IG posts both feed off the article pipeline; Field Guide burns ~5/wk.
steps: Watch the Ops 'runway' tile — it flags under ~2 weeks
Top up leaf_queue / guide_queue before either hits the warning band

items.title: Drop your own IP from GA when traffic grows
items.why: Left in for now (fine at this volume), but once real users show up it'll skew DAU/engagement/new-%.
steps: When the daily-users sparkline lifts and New-users % settles below 100%, activate the GA4 internal-traffic filter (or keep Firefox ETP Strict / Private tabs)

items.title: Ship the new App Store description + confirm iOS→web entitlement
items.why: Promo text is live; the fuller differentiation description rides the next version. Separately, verify a paying iOS user unlocks on web.
steps: Paste the drafted 'generic apps can't ID the good stuff' description into the next app version
Sandbox-purchase test → confirm the Firebase 'subscriber' claim flips and the web wall opens
